name: com.devian.samples
description: Samples for Devian framework. Import samples and customize freely.

samples.description: Common domain: Unity runtime (CommonEffect, MaterialEffect, Module, Unity) + Generated tables/enums.
Sound domain: Sound/Voice managers + Generated tables/enums.
Game domain sample: Ability system + Generated tables/enums.
Bundle sample: installs FirebaseManager + SaveSystem + AccountManager + PurchaseManager together.
Game protocol definitions: C2Game/Game2C network protocol + SessionHost + Networker.
UI components: UIManager, UICanvas, UIFrame, UIPlugIn (Button, Text, CircleFilter, NonDrawing).
